verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi yo evaṁ saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, vīriyārambho.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that leads to the continuation, persistence, and enduring of the true teaching like arousing energy.

verses.pali: Vīriyārambho, bhikkhave, saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattatī”ti.
verses.english: Arousing energy leads to the continuation, persistence, and enduring of the true teaching.”
